integrity.description: The agent actually looked up the '5x5 Beginner' end date before setting the new start date.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the local wger instance at http://localhost.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The prerequisite routine is named '5x5 Beginner'. Its end date is randomized at runtime, so the agent MUST view this routine's details to determine the correct Start Date for the new routine. The new routine must be named exactly 'Intermediate Hypertrophy' and its Start Date must be (5x5 Beginner End Date + 1 day).
